title: Parabolic
overview: A disgraced ex investment banker from the City of London sees an opportunity to rebuild his life, but as fortune rises, relationships fracture and the consequences become impossible to escape.  A young woman living just outside Canary Wharf tries to breakout of her unfortunate financial situation by aligning with a disgraced ex banker in the pursuit of easy money just when things escalate.
